clues.it: Tea era accanto a un cumulo di neve.
clues.en: Tea was beside a snow pile.

clues.it: Olga era nella 9ª colonna e nella 4ª riga.
clues.en: Olga was in the 9th column and in the 4th row.

clues.it: Luca era nella 5ª colonna e nella 5ª riga.
clues.en: Luca was in the 5th column and in the 5th row.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 7ª riga e nella Sala Smistamento.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 7th row and in the Sorting Hall.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª riga e accanto a un mucchio di letterine.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th row and beside a pile of letters.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un albero di Natale.
clues.en: Marta was beside a Christmas tree.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una slitta e a una sedia a dondolo.
clues.en: Nino was beside a sleigh and a rocking chair.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 16ª colonna e nella 12ª riga.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 16th column and in the 12th row.

clues.it: Giada era l'unica persona su dei nastri.
clues.en: Giada was the only person on loose ribbons.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 8ª colonna e nella 14ª riga.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 8th column and in the 14th row.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 16ª riga e a ovest di Sergio, ma non era accanto a dei nastri.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 16th row and west of Sergio, but was not beside loose ribbons.

steps.it: Solo Tea può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 11ª è sua.
steps.en: Tea is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.
